messages:
laura: Quick pulse  marketplace + SI partners asking for non-overlap for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi launches next quarter. Need a minimal gating plan by EOD.

ben: Ill own marketplace quotas. Will post a per-region cap table (small). ETA 6pm.

omar: SI side: partners want 1-2 exclusive demo days each. Recommend reserving slots but keep them adjacent to GA windows.

katie: Comms preference: APAC hard quiet window 72h, EU/US advisory 24-48h. Also want an embargo exception form.

announce-bot: Doc created: https://redwood.company/docs/partners/slot-scrub - reviewers: ben, katie.

laura: Laura: Can someone draft a 4-row matrix region|primary|fallback|press-risk? Keep it tiny.

ben: Draft below:
```
region,primary,fallback,press-risk
us-east,h100,h200,medium
eu-central,mi300,h200,low
apac-south,h100,mi300,high
sa-east,gaudi,mi300,medium
```

omar: Note: gaudi firmware sign-off in EU scheduled next Tue. Marked as firmware-risk if delayed (>48h).

katie: I'll start the embargo exception PR and add APAC hard block.

laura: Action items: ben upload quotas (EOD), omar collect SI exclusives (tomorrow), katie PR embargo playbook (EOD). If any firmware drift >48h escalate to hw-ops. :+1:

ben: Uploaded capacity sheet. Link in doc.

omar: SI exclusives list coming in AM. Some partners asked for exclusive demo day that conflicts with proposed APAC GA window, may need to shift by 2 days.

katie: If we shift GA >48h we need exec signoff. I'll prep language.

laura: Thanks team. Recheck in 24h and lock final matrix.
